## 🔄 firefly-engineering/quartermaster

### ✅ Part 1 — Human session: spec, scaffold and tickets, done

- ✅ The draft spec was reworked onto the worklog format: [spec](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/blob/main/docs/spec.md), [ADRs 0001–0007](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/tree/main/docs/adr), [glossary](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md). Decisions: the worklog format plus manual checkboxes, `owner/repo#N` refs, jj workspaces, no daemon, one jj commit per mutation, skill and MCP prompt from one source, Go.
- ✅ The worklog skill was imported verbatim into `skills/worklog/`. The flake exports the package, the skill plugin and the home-manager module; the toolchain comes from toolbox.
- ✅ Tickets [#1](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/issues/1)–[#16](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/issues/16) filed in milestone v1, with native dependencies. No epic: none of them share one decision.
- ✅ CI moved to `vars.CI_RUNNER` (Blacksmith). Its first run failed lint on Linux ([run](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/actions/runs/39125316259)). [toolbox#7](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/toolbox/issues/7) was filed and fixed, and the repo is now on go-toolchain 7 with Go 1.27, green ([run](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/actions/runs/39126157260)).

### ✅ Part 2 — Human session: three open questions, settled

- ✅ [#14](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/issues/14): mutating tools never refresh; `refresh` runs on demand ([ADR 0008](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-mutating-tools-do-not-refresh.md)), [`6bb791da`](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/commit/6bb791da354b).
- ✅ [#15](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/issues/15): no `## Log` and no `log_event`; jj history is the timeline. [#9](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/issues/9) rescoped. [`f15ebbaa`](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/commit/f15ebbaac325).
- ✅ [#16](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/issues/16): MIT, `LICENSE` and `meta.license`. [`0f009ec5`](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/quartermaster/commit/0f009ec5e92f).
